title: Early Request Days on Homesite Reservation Hold Extensions
content:
A Homesite Reservation hold extension requested well ahead of the hold expiry date earns an extension early bonus, set by the calendar days remaining from today to the current hold expiry date on the reservation.

- At least **10** calendar days remain: an early bonus of **2** days.
- At least **5** but fewer than 10 calendar days remain: an early bonus of **1** day.
- Fewer than 5 calendar days remain: no early bonus.

## Boundary cases

| Days remaining | Early bonus |
|---|---|
| 10 | 2 days |
| 9 | 1 day |
| 5 | 1 day |
| 4 | none |

## Date illustration (hypothetical hold expiry date of 20 July)

Requested on 10 July, 10 days remain and the bonus is 2 days; on 11 July, 9 days remain and the bonus is 1 day; on 16 July, 4 days remain and there is no bonus.
